title: The Sunken Belfry
description: A short coastal mystery set in a flooded chapel tower.

premise.background: Low tide has exposed the upper arches of a drowned coastal belfry for the first time in forty years.
premise.hook: Scholarly chronicler Sera Vance pays the party to recover the brass bell clapper before the tide returns.

locations.name: Salt Cove
locations.summary: A rocky tidal inlet with tide-pools and weathered pilings.

locations.name: Flooded Nave
locations.summary: Waist-deep brackish water inside the broken stone tower.

connections.description: A slick spiral stair climbs toward the loft.

locations.name: The Bell Loft
locations.summary: Timber beams holding a salt-crusted bronze bell above the tide line.

actors.name: Sera Vance
actors.summary: An antiquarian who chartered a skiff to reach the cove at low tide.
actors.motivation: Prove the belfry predates the harbour charter.

scenes.title: Low Tide at Salt Cove
scenes.summary: Sera Vance briefs the party while the water recedes from the belfry arch.

branches.description: Wade into the flooded nave before the tide turns.

scenes.title: Crossing the Nave
scenes.summary: The party navigates fallen masonry and shifting silt to reach the spiral stair.

scenes.title: The Bronze Bell
scenes.summary: The clapper is wedged by barnacles and a rusted iron pin.

encounters.title: The Wedged Bell Pin
encounters.description: Freeing the brass clapper without dropping the cracked timber beam.

alternativeSolutions.method: Pry the rusted pin with a crowbar
alternativeSolutions.description: Brace the cracked beam first so the clapper comes free cleanly.
Sever the strap so the clapper drops into the water below and can be fished out.

clues.text: A mason's mark on the bell yoke predates the town charter by a century.

rumours.text: Fishermen say ringing the bell summons a squall.

items.name: Engraved Brass Clapper
items.summary: Heavy brass bell clapper stamped with an old guild sigil.

secrets.text: The parish vestry hid tax ledgers inside the hollow bell crown before the tower sank.

endings.title: Recovered Before High Tide
endings.description: The party returns to the skiff with the clapper and Sera pays the agreed fee.

unresolved.message: The source text does not specify the exact number of minutes before high tide.
